name: oe-design-system
description: OpenEconomics Design System — token, componenti e UI kit (libreria consultabile)

scripts.predev: npm run icons:zip && npm run maps:zip
scripts.prebuild: npm run icons:zip && npm run maps:zip
scripts.maps:zip: cd public/kit/assets && rm -f mappe.zip && zip -qrX mappe.zip mappe -x 'mappe/.DS_Store'
scripts.icons:zip: cd public/kit/assets && rm -f icons.zip && zip -qrX icons.zip icons -x 'icons/index.html' 'icons/.DS_Store'
